independent_definition_rule.forbidden_shortcut: Q_E := P_C composed with an inverse comparison map, or any definition that queries the truth value/known answer of P_C
independent_definition_rule.permitted: Q_E may use the realized Enterprise state and independently declared Enterprise primitives/operations, with source algebraic data only as explicitly typed inputs

rule_for_one_direction_theorems: A one-direction comparison can support only a downstream claim that logically uses that direction; it cannot be advertised as equivalence.

accepted_strict_leverage_classes.LAYER_LOWERING: a theorem-critical condition is proved equivalent/adequately related to an independently defined lower Enterprise operational layer
accepted_strict_leverage_classes.LOCALIZATION: a global condition is replaced by local/finite constraints together with a proved local-to-global assembly theorem
accepted_strict_leverage_classes.NORMAL_FORM: a coupled/operator relation is transformed to an exact normal form with a declared structural simplification and consequences
accepted_strict_leverage_classes.DEPENDENCY_REDUCTION: a declared global/unbounded dependency is replaced by bounded/local/compositional dependency under an exact theorem
accepted_strict_leverage_classes.FINITE_OBSTRUCTION_BASIS: a broad existence/consistency condition is equivalent to finitely many exact obstruction classes/checks
accepted_strict_leverage_classes.INTEGRALITY_POSITIVITY_MONOTONICITY: an analytic or high-layer condition is related exactly to integer/positivity/monotonicity structure that yields a theorem/exclusion mechanism
accepted_strict_leverage_classes.COMPOSITIONAL_FACTORING: a global proof obligation decomposes into exact composable local obligations with a proved assembly theorem

non_tautology_minimum_checks: Enterprise-side predicate/operator has a definition that does not mention the source theorem truth value
comparison theorem is proved after both sides are defined
known Hodge/algebraic-cycle answers are absent from generator inputs
a relabeling-only transport receives no leverage credit
